description: Shape 6 (mixed512, b640) is at ~1.55× — the weakest speedup among the shapes that DO have a custom win (others hit ~2×), routed through _eigh_mixed_peel. Profile its cost breakdown and attack the dominant sub-cost: the mixed batch peels clustered/rowscale/low-rank matrices but the dense-512 remainder and the two-level projector cost likely dominate. Bring the shape-11 dense wins to shape 6's dense subset — the fp16 NS sign, mixed-finish, and single-pass-CQR that already help the n=512 sign-DC/CQR paths — and/or route shape 6's dense-remainder matrices through the shape-11 sign-DC path (n=512, same size) instead of whole-batch cuSOLVER. Targets the mixed512 dense-remainder redundant-work; keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

t1: PROFILE shape6 (mixed512 b640) + MIXPEEL_DBG diagnostic. Peel decomposition: dense=278, psd=90, clustered=38, rest=234, rest_fallback=0. nsys GPU-kernel time: mega_eigh_clust_split_k (234-matrix rest) = 44.7ms (45.6%, DOMINANT), mega_eigh_med_split_k (dense/psd lowrank) = 13.3ms (13.5%), batch_trsm 6.9ms. Rest is heterogeneous (spectrum/rankdef/repeated/band/rowscale), already on cluster megakernel NOT cuSOLVER (brief hypothesis stale). Rest PR histogram: ~46 at PR<48 (lowrank-able), ~100 at PR 200-300 (dense-even-like). Lever = the 234-matrix rest cluster kernel. Metric unchanged (env-gated diag).

t2: fp16 NS in rest cluster path (_REST_NS_PREC=fp16). MEASURED REGRESSION: shape6 105509->130748us (+24%), geomean 26448->26872. Cluster kernel leaves raw eigvecs orth~0.96 (repeated/degenerate); fp16 NS can't drive under gate -> mass cuSOLVER fallback. Unlike shape-11 sign-DC where NS runs on already-orthonormal Q. TF32 NS is required here. Validation PASS. Reverting to tf32 next.

t3: 3xTF32 orth-gate Gram in rest cluster path (_REST_ORTH_GATE_PREC=3xtf32, was FP32-SIMT). Shape6 105509->104971us (~-0.5%, within noise), geomean 26448->26370. The rest orth gate Q^T Q was true FP32-SIMT (~8ms cutlass_80_simt_sgemm); _gram_3xtf32_sym (~6e-6==FP32, tensor cores) is the same gate shape-11 sign-DC uses. Shapes 3/11 unchanged. Validation PASS, rest_fallback 0. Small clean directionally-right win.

t4: fp16-head+tf32-tail rest NS (_REST_NS_PREC=fp16_then_tf32, head=1). Neutral/slightly-neg: shape6 104971(t3)->105802us (within noise), geomean 26370->26463, rest_fallback 0. fp16 head GEMM saving offset by cast overhead at 2 total NS steps. Reverting to tf32 (t3 best kept). Validation PASS.

t5: 3xtf32 complement projection in mixed peel (_MIXED_PEEL_PROJ_MODE=3xtf32, was fp32). MEASURED REGRESSION: shape6 104971(t3)->106551us (+1.6%), geomean 26370->26516. Ozaki overhead exceeds SIMT->TC saving on the projection GEMMs (confirms brief-54). Reverting to fp32 (t3 best). Validation PASS.

t6: rankdef-band peel PR[62,85) k=384 into fused lowrank (_MIXED_PEEL_RANKDEF=True). MEASURED REGRESSION: rest 234->159 (rest_fallback=0) but shape6 104971(t3)->127692us (+21%). k=384 lowrank reduced-block+CQR2 (~301us/mat) costs more than cluster marginal (~249us/mat); cluster's superlinear->sublinear cost means removing 75 saves less than lowrank adds. Confirms isolated-subset probe. Reverting to t3 best. Validation PASS.

t7: revert to best config (tf32 rest-NS + 3xtf32 orth-gate + fp32 proj + no rankdef). KEEPER. Shape6 105427us (parent 105509, t3 104971 -- 3xtf32 orth-gate ~0.5% within noise the only net win), geomean 26434.6 (parent 26448.877). Shapes 3 (73053) / 11 (70648) unchanged vs parent. rest_fallback 0, validation PASS. Mixed rest is cluster-optimal; clust kernel 44.6ms (45.7% GPU) is barrier-stall/latency-bound at 20% compute (ncu) -- the hard floor.

7 trials on shape6 (mixed512 b640). PARENT geomean 26448.877, shape6 105509us. KEEPER HEAD 1881bc29f: geomean 26434-26448 (flat/noise), shape6 105210-105427us, shapes 3/11 UNCHANGED, 39/39 valid, rest_fallback 0, 'stream' absent, -O3 intact.

DECOMPOSITION (nsys+MIXPEEL_DBG, trial-1 requirement): shape6 peels dense=278(->lowrank k352), psd=90(->lowrank k256), clustered=38(->twolevel), REST=234(->cluster megakernel). GPU-kernel time: mega_eigh_clust_split_k (234-matrix rest) = 44.6ms/45.7% DOMINANT; mega_eigh_med_split_k (dense/psd lowrank reduced-block) = 13.3ms/13.6%; batch_trsm 7.1ms; FP32-SIMT gemms (two-level) ~8ms. The rest is NOT dense-remainder->cuSOLVER (brief hypothesis STALE) -- it already routes to a cluster megakernel, and is heterogeneous (spectrum/rankdef/repeated/band/rowscale), NOT dense-even.

ncu on the clust kernel: 44.66ms, 20.4% compute, 26.7% memory, 0.6% DRAM, 44% occupancy, 71.3% of stall cycles at CTA barriers (load imbalance) -> LATENCY/BARRIER-BOUND compiled SIMT kernel = the HARD FLOOR.

ANSWER to the brief's map question: shape6's 1.55x is CLUSTER-MACHINERY-bound, NOT remainder-improvable. MEASURED (all committed): (t2) fp16 rest-NS -> +24% (cluster raw eigvecs orth~0.09-0.96, fp16 can't recover); (t4) fp16-head+tf32-tail NS -> neutral/neg (cast overhead at 2 steps); (t5) 3xtf32 complement proj -> +1.6% (Ozaki>SIMT-TC saving, confirms brief-54); (t6) rankdef-band peel PR[62,85) k=384 -> +21% (k=384 lowrank ~301us/mat > cluster marginal ~249us/mat; cluster superlinear->sublinear so removing 75 saves less than lowrank adds). PROBED: sign-DC on hi-PR rest (100-234 mat) LOSES to fragmentation (sign-DC needs b>=400 to amortize; 267us/mat at b=200 vs cluster 191us/mat); low-PR rest (spectrum PR~27) NOT lowrank-able (100% internal fallback). NET WIN: only (t3) 3xtf32 orth-gate (~0.5%, within noise) -- kept. NS tf32x2 (1.12ms) is already the cheapest under-gate NS variant (probed x3_then_tf32 slower, x3_x1 over-gate). C=3/NS=2 re-confirmed optimal.

OPEN directions (need a compiled-kernel change, out of this brief's Python scope): (1) the clust kernel's 71% barrier-stall / 20% compute means a tensor-core batched dense-n=512 eigensolver for the rest could in principle beat 44.6ms IF it amortized at b=234 -- sign-DC does at b>=400 but not 234; a rest-specific reduced-precision tensor-core tridiag or a Jacobi-on-tensor-cores kernel is the real lever. (2) combining shape6's rest (234) with shape7 mixed1024 or another mixed shape's dense remainder into one larger sign-DC batch (cross-shape batching) -- not possible in the per-call harness. (3) reducing the ~15ms peel overhead (multiple index_select/index_copy/gather, gate GEMMs) via a fused scatter. The clust kernel itself is the 44.6ms wall; shape6 is peel/cluster-machinery-bound.
